description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of several large language models on a set of Korean evaluation benchmarks, as presented in the paper “RedWhale: An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining.” The horizontal axis lists eight evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG (average), with each category containing three grouped bars representing different models: “RedWhale (our)” (dark purple), “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” (light blue), and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” (light gray). The vertical axis represents performance scores, ranging from 0 to 1.00, with values explicitly labeled atop each bar. In most categories, “RedWhale (our)” achieves competitive or leading scores—for example, 0.42 in PT-EVAL, 0.52 in KoBEST-BQ, 0.71 in KoBEST-CP, 0.50 in KoBEST-HS, 0.69 in KoBEST-SN, and 0.57 on AVG—while “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” often scores 1.00, suggesting it may serve as a normalized or ceiling benchmark. The chart is tilted diagonally for layout purposes, and the bars are grouped by task, allowing direct comparison of model performance across benchmarks. The “AVG” category summarizes overall performance, with RedWhale scoring 0.57, EEVE-Korean 0.61, and SOLAR 1.00.
